name: canvas-scholar-mcp
description: Check your Canvas assignments, grades, discussions, missing work, and planner — read-only and student-scoped.
long_description: A student-focused Canvas LMS MCP server. It reads only your own data (your courses, your grades, your submissions) over a read-only connection to your school's Canvas. Nothing is written back to Canvas, and your API token is stored in your OS keychain, never in a plaintext config file.

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas API token
canvas_api_token.description: Create at Canvas → Account → Settings → '+ New Access Token'. Set an expiration date.
